stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script with broad terms prints about 4.5M chars of snippets; the run stops with the context full, before any response is written.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Scan document text with an extraction script
runs.failure_point: An unbounded scan dump filled the context; no response.md was produced.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Ran a store-wide scan with broad terms and no output cap; its 4.5M-char output overflowed the context and the run ended without a deliverable.

divergence: Passing runs (T0, T1) found the matter with file- and folder-name searches and opened its court documents. T2's first move after the listing was a store-wide extraction scan with broad terms and no output cap; the 4.5M-char result overflowed the context and the run ended with no response.
